title: sas-proc-freq analysis_config.json
description: Configuration schema for SAS PROC FREQ compatible categorical analysis in R.

input.description: Path to the input CSV file.

output_dir.description: Output root directory. Runner isolates output into run_<first 16 chars of run_id>/.

tables.description: List of table requests to compute.

table_id.description: Unique identifier for this table request.

col_var.description: Column variable name (null or omitted for 1-way frequency table).

count_var.description: Observation count/weight variable name (WEIGHT count equivalent). If omitted or null, each row counts as 1.

levels_order.description: Explicit ordering of levels for variables to prevent locale or appearance-order drift.

event_level.description: Event level for column variable in 2x2 effect size and binomial proportion calculations.

comparison_direction.description: Direction of comparison for row variable in 2x2 tables (e.g. 'Trt_vs_Pbo').

missing_mode.description: Missing value handling mode: exclude (SAS default), missprint, or include.

chisq.description: Whether to compute Chi-Square tests (Pearson, Likelihood Ratio, Continuity-Adjusted).

measures.description: Whether to compute 2x2 effect sizes (Odds Ratio, Relative Risk).

binomial.description: Whether to compute binomial proportion confidence intervals.

binomial_methods.description: List of binomial confidence interval methods to compute.

binomial_level.description: Target level for binomial proportion estimation. If omitted, uses event_level or first level.

alpha.description: Significance level for confidence intervals (1 - alpha).

structural_zeros.description: List of known structural zero cells.

method.description: Fisher test method: none, exact, or monte_carlo.

timeout_sec.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for child process.

workspace_bytes.description: Workspace limit in bytes (converted to min(floor(bytes/4), 2147483647) for R fisher.test workspace argument in general R x C tables).

fallback_to_mc.description: If true, automatically fallback to Monte Carlo estimation when exact computation exceeds resource limits.

mc_sampling_algorithm.description: v1 implements patefield only; awb is reserved and rejected at validate time.

mc_replications.description: Number of Monte Carlo replicates B.

mc_seed.description: Random seed for Monte Carlo simulation.

mc_alpha.description: Significance level for Monte Carlo confidence interval (1 - mc_alpha).
